text:
Based on your preference for historical fiction set in the medieval period, with a focus on political intrigue and warfare, and your enjoyment of authors like Ken Follett and Bernard Cornwell, here are some book recommendations:

1. "The Pillars of the Earth" by Ken Follett
2. "The Warlord Chronicles" by Bernard Cornwell
3. "The Name of the Rose" by Umberto Eco
4. "The Book of the New Sun" by Gene Wolfe
5. "The Last Kingdom" by Bernard Cornwell
6. "The World of Splendors" by Ken Follett
7. "The Lion of Justice" by Bernard Cornwell
8. "The Fall of Kings" by Bernard Cornwell
9. "The Key to Revelation" by Ken Follett
10. "The Winter King" by Bernard Cornwell
